note: Held-out matching set (Increment 4, RQ-6): written on Oct 28, 2026, after the matching settings were frozen, and labelled before the first run. Harder than profiles.json: every vacancy is open to all eight computing majors (15 eligible vacancies per profile), and each vacancy lists one skill only, so the description carries the meaning.

vacancies.title: Platform Engineering Trainee
vacancies.description: Help the platform team keep the company's services running: package applications in containers, write deployment pipelines, and watch dashboards for failing services.

vacancies.title: Mobile Banking App Trainee
vacancies.description: Build screens of the bank's customer app for Android and iPhone from one code base, connect them to the account services, and test them on real phones.

vacancies.title: Fraud Analytics Trainee
vacancies.description: Study card transactions to find patterns of fraud, build simple models that score risky payments, and explain the results to the risk team.

vacancies.title: Threat Monitoring Trainee
vacancies.description: Watch the alerts of the security operations centre, investigate suspicious logins and malware, and write incident notes for the analysts on shift.

vacancies.title: Web Portal Trainee
vacancies.description: Develop pages of the customer portal, from the browser side to the services behind it, and fix bugs reported by customers.

vacancies.title: Reporting and Dashboards Trainee
vacancies.description: Turn the monthly sales spreadsheets into interactive dashboards for managers and automate the data refresh.

vacancies.title: Network Operations Trainee
vacancies.description: Configure switches and routers in the branches, monitor the links between sites, and help the team plan the new office network.

vacancies.title: Quality Engineering Trainee
vacancies.description: Write automated checks for the web and mobile releases, report defects with clear steps, and join the release review every sprint.

vacancies.title: Chatbot Trainee
vacancies.description: Help build an Arabic customer-service assistant: prepare conversation data, test language models, and measure how well it answers questions.

vacancies.title: Product Design Trainee
vacancies.description: Interview users, sketch new screens, and turn them into clickable prototypes that the developers can follow.

vacancies.title: Systems Integration Trainee
vacancies.description: Connect the finance system with the warehouse system through services and file exchanges, and document each data flow.

vacancies.title: Cloud Infrastructure Trainee
vacancies.description: Create and secure virtual servers, storage, and networks in the public cloud, and keep the monthly cost under control.

vacancies.title: IT Service Desk Trainee
vacancies.description: Answer employee requests by phone and chat, set up laptops and accounts, and keep the knowledge base up to date.

vacancies.title: Data Platform Trainee
vacancies.description: Move data from operational databases into the analytics platform every night and check that the numbers match.

vacancies.title: Smart Devices Trainee
vacancies.description: Program small boards that read sensors in the factory and send the readings to a central server.

profiles.cv: Software engineering student who built two Flutter apps: a campus events app with Firebase sign-in and a budget tracker published on Google Play. Likes clean user interfaces and testing on real devices.
Cybersecurity student. Completed a SOC analyst course, analysed packet captures, wrote detection rules for failed logins in a home lab, and took part in two capture-the-flag competitions.

Data science student. Course project: predicting loan default from customer data with gradient boosting; another project on detecting unusual transactions in a public card-payment dataset. Comfortable explaining results to non-technical people.
Computer engineering student. Built a greenhouse monitor with an ESP32 that sends temperature and humidity to a server over MQTT, and a line-following robot for a university competition.
Information systems student who prepared monthly KPI reports in Excel for a family business and rebuilt them as Power BI dashboards that refresh automatically.
طالب شبكات واتصالات حاصل على شهادة CCNA. صممت شبكة لمبنى من ثلاثة طوابق في مشروع المقرر مع شبكات افتراضية وتوجيه بين الفروع، وتدربت على ضبط جدار ناري.
طالبة هندسة برمجيات بنت متجراً إلكترونياً بواجهة React وخادم Node.js مع سلة مشتريات ودفع تجريبي، وأصلحت أخطاء في موقع جمعية خيرية كعمل تطوعي.
طالب علوم حاسب عمل على مشروع تخرج لتصنيف تغريدات عربية حسب المشاعر، وجرّب نماذج لغوية كبيرة للإجابة عن أسئلة الطلاب حول الجدول الدراسي.
طالبة نظم معلومات إدارية عملت بدوام جزئي في مكتب الدعم الفني بالكلية، تجهّز أجهزة الموظفين وتنشئ حساباتهم وترد على البلاغات عبر نظام التذاكر.
طالب نظم معلومات حاسوبية كتب اختبارات آلية لتطبيق ويب بأداة Selenium خلال مشروع جماعي، ويسجل العيوب بخطوات واضحة في Jira ويشارك في مراجعة كل إصدار.
